quest.title: Hundred-Pace Hurling Rites
quest.description: Ting Zhi is busy near Wangshu Inn...

dialogues.speaker: Ting Zhi
dialogues.text: Hmm... Now it shouldn't be too difficult...

dialogues.speaker: Ting Zhi
dialogues.text: I'm setting up the game I'm responsible for... Have you heard of "Hundred-Pace Hurling Rites"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You want me to conduct a bunch of rites to chuck things long distances?

dialogues.speaker: Ting Zhi
dialogues.text: You... are very perceptive, and got it half right! The core game mechanics do revolve around "throwing," but that's not what "rites" means here.

dialogues.speaker: Ting Zhi
dialogues.text: I learned about this game from an ancient book. Let me briefly walk you through it...

dialogues.speaker: Ting Zhi
dialogues.text: The traditional rules dictate that all participants in this game must be sitting down, as part of the rites.

dialogues.speaker: Ting Zhi
dialogues.text: Well, you must also adopt a special sitting posture, which I will not demonstrate for you at this time, since I don't have any cushions here...

dialogues.speaker: Ting Zhi
dialogues.text: From their sitting positions, the participants must follow the music's rhythm and "throw" the "Darts" into the distant "pots."

dialogues.speaker: Ting Zhi
dialogues.text: There are many ways to throw the Darts into the pots, each with their own special names.

dialogues.speaker: Ting Zhi
dialogues.text: For example, the first Dart to land in the pot is called the "First." If the subsequent Dart also lands in the vessel, it's called a "Streak."

dialogues.speaker: Ting Zhi
dialogues.text: If the Dart hits the handles of the pot, it's called "Piercing." If a Dart is thrown through the neck before bouncing out of the pot, it's called "Valiant."

response.speaker: Ting Zhi
response.text: Don't worry. I just told you these are the "traditional rules."

response.speaker: Ting Zhi
response.text: But I have simplified them for everyone's convenience.

response.speaker: Ting Zhi
response.text: Ahem! Anyway, all you need to know is that the goal is to throw as many Darts into the pots as you can before time runs out... I'll take care of the rest!

response.speaker: Ting Zhi
response.text: I mean... The rule book does say that whoever tosses the most Darts into the pot wins...

response.speaker: Ting Zhi
response.text: As for the rules that require the loser to drink and write a poem... I can't really ask every player who loses to do all that now, now can I?

response.speaker: Ting Zhi
response.text: Anyways! I'm almost done setting up the game. The Holding Pots are over there. I'll get you the Darts momentarily.

response.speaker: Ting Zhi
response.text: You can try it now if you're interested.

choices.text: Th—There's no way to remember all that!

response.speaker: Ting Zhi
response.text: Don't worry, you don't need to remember all those terms, they... Ugh... Remembering them is my job.
